question: Can an explicit per-entity unknown-reason ledger distinguish unavailable evidence from profile-expression limits, without changing acceptance?

arms.image_input: original ten-frame capture for each window

arms.prompt: driving_v2_3 plus only the preregistered unknown-reason ledger instruction

only_changed_variable: Prompt instruction asking the base model to encode a per-object/road/traffic diagnostic ledger inside the existing confidence_note string; no runtime acceptance or schema changes

ledger.format: JSON text in existing confidence_note; ordinary hypothesis premises preserved under premises_text
ledger.restrictions: Self-reported reasons are not established facts or calibrated guarantees. Do not clear unknowns, invent bounds, delete adverse modes, relabel unsupported scale, or add unrelated frames to obtain acceptance.
ledger.runtime_use: NONE; offline diagnosis only; existing T1 does not parse the ledger

fixed_conditions.model_requested: gpt-6.1-sol; actual returned identity must be recorded; no silent fallback
fixed_conditions.vehicle_safety_target_capture: Original frozen capture/config bytes for the corresponding window
fixed_conditions.tool_rules: Current committed source, including category-only MISSING_SCALE fix; freeze exact source and prompts before any calls
fixed_conditions.arm_order: Interleave by window, alternating control-first and diagnostic-first in the listed cohort order; record timestamps; do not claim deterministic model pairing

primary_diagnostic_outputs: All ledger reason slots with absence/parse-failure rates and source pointers; model assertions remain unverified
Original-field changes and all independently evaluable T1 predicates; no posthoc object identity assumption
Actual first-stage rejection, first-call and within-one-revision full-chain outcomes, separately for original four and exploratory two
full_chain_conditional_success: Fresh real image/model record with valid provenance; T1/T2/T3 pass; independent raw-scene continuous T4 pass; strict acceptor passes; verified 0.2s prefix receipt agrees with integration. Label MOVING_PREFIX versus STATIONARY_HOLD. Model-scene assumptions/coverage remain conditions; single-window replay is not multi-round counterfactual driving.

g2.phase: Offline after runtime artifacts are sealed; no feedback into model/tools
g2.report: All missing/unmatched denominators, fixed focal targets, current positions/speeds/road extent and future annotation-surrogate metrics separately
g2.thresholds: NOT_SET_NO_G2_PASS_CLAIM; scientifically meaningful numerical acceptance thresholds require separate confirmation before registration

stops: No launch without explicit user confirmation and frozen prompt/source/config hashes
Stop an arm-window after success, at most one semantic revision, or service/timeout failure; no replacement calls

Stop the whole batch on authentication/quota/model-unavailable failures, unexpected model identity, immutable input/source hash mismatch, any GT access from runtime, total invocation or wall budget exhaustion
Do not replace windows, enlarge budgets, alter unknown/safety requirements, change models, or start a follow-up batch automatically
